parameters.name: Bandwidth
parameters.description: The peak bandwidth of the EIP. Default value: 5. Valid values: 5 to 10000. Unit: Mbit/s.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
Ensures the idempotence of the request to prevent duplicate operations caused by multiple retries.

- Generate a parameter value from your client and make sure that the value is unique among different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

- If you use a ClientToken that has been used before and the other request parameters remain unchanged, the client receives the same result as the first submission, without affecting the server-side state.

- You can retry when the API times out or returns the PROCESSING error code. Idempotence is effective in this case. If the response returns an HTTP 200 status code, the retry returns the same result as the previous call without affecting the server-side state. If the response returns an HTTP 4xx status code and the error code is not PROCESSING, idempotence is not effective.

- The ClientToken is valid for 10 minutes.

parameters.name: EnsRegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the Edge Node Service (ENS) edge zone.

parameters.name: InstanceChargeType
parameters.description: Billable methods of the EIP. Currently, only **PostPaid** (pay-as-you-go billing method) is supported.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the EIP.

parameters.name: InternetChargeType
parameters.description: Billable methods of the EIP. Currently, only **95BandwidthByMonth** (monthly 95th percentile bandwidth billing) is supported.

parameters.name: Isp
parameters.description:
The Internet service provider (ISP). Valid values:

- **cmcc**: China Mobile.
- **unicom**: China Unicom.
- **telecom**: China Telecom.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the EIP instance.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The tag key of the instance. Valid values of N: **1** to **20**.

- Cannot start with `aliyun`, `acs:`, `http://`, or `https://`.
- Can be up to 64 characters in length.
- Cannot be an empty string.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The tag value. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, or contain `http://` or `https://`.
